name: lantern-agent
description: A private coding agent that asks before it acts. Uses the AI you already have (Ollama, LM Studio, Jan, GPT4All and more, no terminal needed) or pasted API keys, relayed free tiers first with automatic failover; carry your setup anywhere with an encrypted Lantern Pass. Streaming, diff previews, chat history, /undo. Zero dependencies.
author: JAMMx2
